set -e
mkdir -p public/audio
cat > README.md <<'EOF'
# Crazy Putt Arena

Crazy Putt Arena is an original browser-based arcade mini-golf game built with TypeScript, Three.js and Rapier 3D. One human player competes against configurable bot opponents across a sequence of themed holes: aim with the mouse, charge the shot with the power meter, and let arcade-tuned ball physics do the rest. Ten courses of nine holes each mix ramps, bumpers, conveyors, fans, teleporters and hazard zones, and every match ends with a scoreboard, rating update and progression rewards.

## Requirements

- Node.js 20 or newer
- A modern desktop browser with WebGL 2 (Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari)

## Install

```bash
npm install
```

## Run

```bash
npm run dev
```

Vite prints a local URL (http://localhost:5173 by default); open it in the browser.

## Build

```bash
npm run build
```

The production build type-checks the project first and then emits the bundle into `dist/`.

## Typecheck

```bash
npm run typecheck
```

## Test

```bash
npm run test:ui      # UI layer (src/ui)
npm run test:input   # input and developer tools (src/input, src/dev)
npm run test:camera  # camera system (src/camera)
```

## Project structure

All gameplay code lives under `src/`:

| Folder | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| `app` | top-level game state wiring |
| `ai` | bot planners, bot profiles, matchmaking and skill rating |
| `assets` | asset and audio managers with graceful fallbacks |
| `camera` | camera controller, modes, smoothing and collision avoidance |
| `config` | tunable game configuration values |
| `contracts` | shared types for events, math, services and zones |
| `core` | renderer, scene manager and save manager |
| `courses` | course builder, hole model and the course data sets |
| `dev` | launch options, diagnostics overlay and presentation minimap |
| `effects` | particle effects |
| `gameplay` | match flow, turns, scoring, rating, state machine and zones |
| `input` | keyboard, mouse and touch-ready input handling |
| `leaderboard` | leaderboard model, generator and styles |
| `obstacles` | rotating parts, conveyors, fans, pads, teleporters |
| `physics` | physics world, ball physics, shot system and collision layers |
| `player` | player profile, progression and types |
| `ui` | HUD, overlays, scoreboard and DOM helpers |

## Debug mode

Debug features are enabled through URL flags (see `src/dev/LaunchOptions.ts`):

| Flag | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `?debug=1` | enable debug mode and the developer overlay |
| `?course=<id>` | start directly on the given course |
| `?hole=<n>` | start directly on the given hole number |

Available course ids: `green-hills`, `pirate-bay`, `candy-factory`, `ancient-temple`, `arctic-base`, `volcano`, `neon-city`, `haunted-mansion`, `space-station`, `chaos-dimension`.

Example: `http://localhost:5173/?debug=1&course=volcano&hole=4`

Hotkeys available while debug mode is active:

| Key | Effect |
| --- | --- |
| `F1` | toggle the diagnostics overlay |
| `F2` | toggle wireframe rendering |
| `F3` | toggle the minimap |

## Audio assets

`public/audio` holds the placeholder structure for sound. No audio binaries are committed to the repository: `public/audio/manifest.json` lists every audio event the game can play, using the definition shape consumed by `src/assets/AudioManager.ts` (`id`, `url`, `category`, `volume`, `loop`, `optional`). Every entry is marked `optional`, so the AudioManager treats a missing file as a non-fatal fallback and the game simply runs silently.

To enable sound, drop `.mp3` files into `public/audio/<category>/<id>.mp3` matching the manifest entries. See `public/audio/README.md` for the folder layout and naming rules.
EOF
cat > public/audio/README.md <<'EOF'
# Audio placeholders

This folder is the drop-in location for the game audio. It is intentionally shipped without binaries — the repository contains only the manifest and this note.

## Layout

```
public/audio/
  manifest.json   # list of every audio event the game can play
  sfx/            # gameplay sounds (ball hit, bounces, hazards, hole)
  ui/             # interface feedback (clicks, victory, defeat)
  music/          # looping music tracks
  ambient/        # looping ambience beds
```

## Manifest

`manifest.json` has the form `{ "version": 1, "events": [ ... ] }`. Each entry matches the `AudioEventDefinition` shape used by `src/assets/AudioManager.ts`:

```json
{ "id": "hit", "url": "/audio/sfx/hit.mp3", "category": "sfx", "volume": 0.9, "optional": true }
```

All entries are `optional: true`, so a missing file is reported as a fallback instead of an error and the game keeps running silently.

## Naming rule

One file per event, MP3 only, named after the event id and stored in the folder matching its category:

```
/audio/<category>/<id>.mp3
```

Adding a new sound means adding both the file and a matching manifest entry.

## Licensing

Do not add copyrighted music or sound effects. Only original recordings or assets under a licence that permits redistribution in this project may be placed here.
EOF
cat > public/audio/manifest.json <<'EOF'
{
  "version": 1,
  "events": [
    { "id": "hit", "url": "/audio/sfx/hit.mp3", "category": "sfx", "volume": 0.9, "optional": true },
    { "id": "wall-bounce", "url": "/audio/sfx/wall-bounce.mp3", "category": "sfx", "volume": 0.7, "optional": true },
    { "id": "bumper", "url": "/audio/sfx/bumper.mp3", "category": "sfx", "volume": 0.8, "optional": true },
    { "id": "water", "url": "/audio/sfx/water.mp3", "category": "sfx", "volume": 0.8, "optional": true },
    { "id": "lava", "url": "/audio/sfx/lava.mp3", "category": "sfx", "volume": 0.8, "optional": true },
    { "id": "hole", "url": "/audio/sfx/hole.mp3", "category": "sfx", "volume": 1, "optional": true },
    { "id": "teleport", "url": "/audio/sfx/teleport.mp3", "category": "sfx", "volume": 0.8, "optional": true },
    { "id": "boost", "url": "/audio/sfx/boost.mp3", "category": "sfx", "volume": 0.8, "optional": true },
    { "id": "menu-click", "url": "/audio/ui/menu-click.mp3", "category": "ui", "volume": 0.6, "optional": true },
    { "id": "victory", "url": "/audio/ui/victory.mp3", "category": "ui", "volume": 0.9, "optional": true },
    { "id": "defeat", "url": "/audio/ui/defeat.mp3", "category": "ui", "volume": 0.9, "optional": true },
    { "id": "theme-menu", "url": "/audio/music/theme-menu.mp3", "category": "music", "volume": 0.5, "loop": true, "optional": true },
    { "id": "theme-course", "url": "/audio/music/theme-course.mp3", "category": "music", "volume": 0.45, "loop": true, "optional": true },
    { "id": "ambient-wind", "url": "/audio/ambient/ambient-wind.mp3", "category": "ambient", "volume": 0.35, "loop": true, "optional": true },
    { "id": "ambient-cave", "url": "/audio/ambient/ambient-cave.mp3", "category": "ambient", "volume": 0.35, "loop": true, "optional": true }
  ]
}
EOF
node -e "const m=require('./public/audio/manifest.json');const ids=m.events.map(e=>e.id);const cats=new Set(['music','sfx','ui','ambient']);if(m.version!==1)throw new Error('version');if(ids.length!==15)throw new Error('expected 15 events, got '+ids.length);if(new Set(ids).size!==15)throw new Error('duplicate ids');for(const e of m.events){if(!cats.has(e.category))throw new Error('bad category '+e.category);if(e.url!=='/audio/'+e.category+'/'+e.id+'.mp3')throw new Error('bad url '+e.url);if(e.optional!==true)throw new Error('not optional: '+e.id);}console.log('manifest OK: '+ids.length+' unique events');"
npx tsc -b --pretty false
echo "TSC_EXIT=$?"
git status --short
